name_en: Wilf theorem on graph eigenvalues and chromatic number
canonical_name: Wilf spectral bound for graph coloring
literal_source_claim_en: A spectral lower bound for the chromatic number.
statement_blocker: The closed primary article was not available for lawful statement inspection, while the catalog's literal 'spectral lower bound for the chromatic number' does not select the familiar Wilf upper bound chi(G) <= 1 + lambda_1(G), its rearranged lower bound lambda_1(G) >= chi(G) - 1, an equality classification, or a different least-eigenvalue result. Exact graph, connectedness, chromatic-number, eigenvalue, coercion, and boundary conventions must be frozen from admitted source text and independently reviewed.
domain_and_universes: Expected finite undirected loopless simple graphs with a finite vertex carrier, natural or ENat chromatic number, a real adjacency matrix, and an ordered real eigenvalue family; exact carrier, universes, Fintype/Nonempty/DecidableRel instances, connectedness, and representation remain open.
conclusion: Open pending primary source admission. A versioned modern source attributes to Wilf chi(G) <= 1 + lambda_1(G), equivalently lambda_1(G) >= chi(G) - 1, and reports equality exactly for complete graphs or odd cycles.
degenerate_case_status: No case is formally excluded at intake because no canonical proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every carrier, connectivity, colorability, eigenvalue-index, component, complete-graph, and cycle boundary listed in scope-map.md.
